self.title: Can Identical Beginnings Lead to Different Values?

detail.title: Divergent Values in Path-Dependent Systems
detail.question: Can two systems with identical initial configurations develop fundamentally different value systems based on distinct interaction trajectories?
detail.reason: Parking project to comply with capacity constraints and prioritize research rotation to responsibility_formation.

detail.title: Path-Dependent Value Divergence Mechanisms
detail.summary: Path dependence in value systems is structurally analogous to institutional liberalization and spatial boundary navigation. Divergence emerges when initial conditions constrain subsequent state-space exploration through path-dependent institutional or boundary feedback mechanisms.
detail.reason: Revision incorporating new institutional design and neural representation evidence to deepen the path-dependence model.

detail.title: Path-Dependent Value Divergence Mechanisms
detail.summary: Path dependence in multi-agent value systems is mediated by interaction artifacts and can be modulated by metacognitive intervention frameworks.
detail.reason: Synthesizing available evidence to address the core inquiry of project proj-divergent-values-01 regarding path-dependent divergence.
